name: Kitchen knife skills
description: Prepare ingredients safely and consistently by choosing suitable cuts, controlling the knife, and keeping the work surface stable.
emoji_rationale: The knife is the defining tool of this practical technique.

levels.name: Safe basics
levels.completion_criterion: Set up a stable cutting board and demonstrate a safe grip and guiding-hand position while cutting one soft ingredient into pieces.
levels.can_do: Use a kitchen knife with controlled, deliberate movements and keep fingertips out of the blade path.
levels.safety_requirements: Use a stable board; cut away from the body where appropriate; keep fingers clear and the knife sharp and controlled.

levels.name: Consistent cuts
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare two different ingredients with reasonably even slices and cubes, with pieces cooking or serving consistently.
levels.can_do: Choose a suitable basic cut and maintain control and consistency across different ingredients.
levels.safety_requirements: Maintain a stable board and safe guiding-hand position; do not rush for speed.

levels.name: Confident prep
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare a small meal’s ingredients using at least three suitable cut types while keeping the work area organised and safe.
levels.can_do: Select and execute useful cuts with consistent size and safe workflow.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep the work area uncluttered, carry knives safely, and store them securely after use.

name: Cook rice reliably
description: Control water, heat, timing, and resting so rice cooks evenly and reaches the intended texture. The progression focuses on method and consistency rather than collecting rice recipes.
emoji_rationale: A direct, recognisable symbol for the specific foundational cooking technique.

levels.name: Follow a method
levels.completion_criterion: Cook one batch of rice using a reliable method and produce grains that are cooked through without a pool of excess water.
levels.can_do: Measure ingredients and follow a basic rice-cooking sequence.
levels.safety_requirements: Handle hot pans and steam carefully.

levels.name: Control texture
levels.completion_criterion: Repeat the method successfully twice and identify how rinsing, liquid ratio, heat, or resting affected the texture.
levels.can_do: Adjust the process to avoid a wet, hard, or scorched result.
levels.safety_requirements: Use suitable cookware and keep the lid and hot steam clear of the face.

levels.name: Adapt independently
levels.completion_criterion: Prepare rice for two different meal contexts and explain the process change needed for the target texture or serving time.
levels.can_do: Choose and adapt a method based on quantity, desired texture, and timing.
levels.safety_requirements: Refrigerate cooked rice promptly when not serving immediately and follow local food-safety guidance.

name: Basic baking techniques
description: Learn how ingredient handling and mixing methods affect baked results, including kneading dough, rubbing fat into flour, and making batter. This is a technique skill, not a separate skill for every baked dish.
emoji_rationale: A mixing bowl represents the shared preparation techniques without reducing the skill to one baked dish.

levels.name: Prepare and mix
levels.completion_criterion: Measure ingredients and make one simple batter or rubbed-in mixture with the texture described by a trustworthy recipe.
levels.can_do: Recognise the initial texture cues for a basic baking mixture and avoid obvious overmixing.
levels.safety_requirements: Use oven mitts for hot trays and follow safe handling instructions for equipment.

levels.name: Work the mixture
levels.completion_criterion: Make a simple dough and demonstrate controlled kneading until it reaches the recipe’s stated texture, or explain why the chosen mixture should not be kneaded.
levels.can_do: Choose between mixing, rubbing-in, and kneading based on the type of mixture.
levels.safety_requirements: Clean work surfaces and avoid cross-contact with allergens where relevant.

levels.name: Choose and troubleshoot
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a simple baked item and identify one evidence-based adjustment after evaluating its texture or structure.
levels.can_do: Select a suitable mixing technique and make a reasoned adjustment to improve consistency.
levels.safety_requirements: Check doneness appropriately and handle hot cookware safely.

name: Pan-searing and browning
description: Use surface dryness, pan heat, spacing, and timing to create even browning while cooking food to an appropriate doneness. Steak is an example for practice, not a separate skill.
emoji_rationale: The pan directly represents the heat-control technique.

levels.name: Create a sear
levels.completion_criterion: Brown a suitable food item in a pan without crowding it and identify the visual signs of a properly browned surface.
levels.can_do: Prepare the surface and manage pan contact to encourage browning rather than steaming.
levels.safety_requirements: Keep hands away from splattering fat and use appropriate heat-resistant tools.

levels.name: Control the heat
levels.completion_criterion: Repeat the technique with more even browning and explain how pan heat, moisture, and crowding affected the outcome.
levels.can_do: Adjust heat and batch size to produce a consistent result.
levels.safety_requirements: Avoid overheating oil and manage splattering safely.

levels.name: Manage doneness
levels.completion_criterion: Cook a suitable item to a stated doneness using a reliable timing or thermometer method and allow an appropriate rest where relevant.
levels.can_do: Coordinate browning with safe, appropriate internal doneness instead of judging colour alone.
levels.safety_requirements: Follow trusted food-safety temperature guidance for the specific food.

levels.name: Combine balance and movement

name: Hiking and trail preparation

levels.name: Prepare a short local walk
levels.completion_criterion: Choose a familiar short route, check the forecast, footwear and water needs, and tell someone the planned route when appropriate.

levels.name: Follow a marked trail

levels.can_do: Match route length and terrain to current ability and conditions.

levels.name: Plan an unfamiliar route
levels.completion_criterion: Create a route plan with expected timing, navigation backup, essentials, a turnaround point and a plan for changing conditions.

name: Running and pacing
description: Practise relaxed running or run-walk intervals with a controlled pace and a repeatable routine rather than chasing speed.

levels.completion_criterion: Complete a comfortable 10-minute session alternating short easy runs and walking, adjusting intervals before form breaks down.
levels.can_do: Choose an easy pace and use walking breaks deliberately.

levels.name: Maintain an easy pace
levels.completion_criterion: Complete a 15-minute easy run or run-walk session while maintaining a pace that allows short sentences and finishing in control.
levels.can_do: Regulate effort through breathing and perception rather than speed alone.

levels.name: Plan and review a session
levels.completion_criterion: Plan a comfortable 20–30-minute run-walk session, adjust pace to route and conditions, and note what pacing pattern felt sustainable.
levels.can_do: Make repeatable pacing decisions and reflect on the session without relying on a personal-best result.

levels.name: Run-walk on an easy trail

levels.name: Manage varied surfaces
levels.completion_criterion: Complete an easy loop with a few gentle changes of surface while staying in control and choosing stable footing.

levels.name: Plan a suitable trail session

levels.can_do: You can record one reading without changing the meter.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not open pipes or fittings. If you smell gas, leave and contact the local emergency service. Do not investigate the smell.

levels.name: Compare two readings

levels.name: Explain the record

levels.can_do: You can hand over a reading that another person can check.
levels.safety_requirements: Do not adjust the meter or estimate a digit you could not see.
